Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study focuses on protein-protein interactions (PPI) using AP-MS. While the biological discussion mentions ubiquitination, the MS search parameters provided in the text and PRIDE metadata do not include diGly or other ubiquitin-specific remnants, and PRIDE explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'. Therefore, a standard protein-level LFQ workflow is most appropriate.
